decision.reasoning_trace: I selected the Hexgears Impulse - Hot-swap Mechanical Keyboard as the final choice due to its high rating (4.6), large number of reviews (166), and the overall positive feedback from customers. The consideration set includes a mix of high-end and budget-friendly options, as well as wireless and wired keyboards, to cater to different customer preferences. The Hexgears Impulse stands out for its fully programmable QMK VIA, hot-swappable switches, and high-quality PBT keycaps.
